summary: Adeia Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 5.02, 8.01, 9.01) disclosing that CEO Paul E. Davis notified the Board of his intention to step down as CEO and director to focus on health and personal pursuits, effective upon naming a successor, with a target search completion by Q4 2026. There is no disagreement with the company; Davis will remain in his roles during the transition. The Board has launched a search process. No deal terms apply. The filing triggers no risk-arb or M&A event; the watch item is the timing and selection of a new CEO.
